newsitem.title: USA: IBM stock rises after positive Prudential comment.
newsitem.headline: IBM stock rises after positive Prudential comment.

text.p: The stock of International Business Machines Corp. jumped Friday after Prudential Securities made positive comments about the company's upcoming mainframe computer announcement, traders said.
IBM plans to introduce the next upgrade of its low-cost CMOS mainframe computer line on Tuesday.
Prudential analyst Don Young's office confirmed he made positive comments about the announcement, but Young was not immediately available.
IBM stock was up $2.50 at $115.625 in active trading on the New York Stock Exchange in mid-afternoon.
IBM's newest mainframe models, which have faster processing power, have been widely anticipated by Wall Street and IBM customers.
IBM executives were also holding a meeting on Friday with securities analysts to discuss their Internet strategy, but it was not expected to produce any news.
